decisions.context:
Removing the file changes every commit hash. Your two co-contributors push daily, so they must re-clone or rebase onto the new main, and any push of theirs in between is lost or conflicts.
Force-push: I rewrite and push with --force-with-lease; I can only verify the result on my side.
Leave local: I keep the cleaned copy in a scratch clone and do not touch origin.
